subject: Summer of (cinematic) Love
author: Gooner Rhyle
body:
Agreed...this has been amazing summer at the cinema, especially for geeks like me.

Iron Man and Incredible Hulk were both tremendous, Hancock got lost on it's way to being an even passable movie (although full marks for the cast - Jason Bateman is quality and Charlize Theron....I'll shut up on her as I'm about to sound like a perv...), X-Files 2 was good but not great but the highlight was The Dark Knight. Did myself a favour and avoided as much as I could of the jumping-the-gun 'best movie ever' hype and waited to see it myself and boy am I glad I did. Loved every minute, even those with Maggie Gyllenhaal. Sure she's pretty, but can she act?

The only real let-down of the summer has been Indy 4. A good movie ruined by one character and in particular one moment where I sat there and said 'I'm not buying it' Mutt - Lord of the Apes. Absolute bollocks.

Going to see Hellboy 2 next weekend and can't wait and there's still more great movies to come this summer - Step Brothers, Tropic Thunder, Pineapple Express,  Wall-E...good times for cinemaphiles!

subject: Forbidden Kingdom 5 stars?
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
I thought that movie was only a 4. Here's my argument: Its got Jet Li and Jackie Chan in it. look at previous movies that they have made, Drunken master the original one from 1980s and Hero. There was actually a good plot and story to it. the drama in hero was great and I felt that I could just watch it over and over again. This movie I think they fell a little bit short. I could watch it, but it doesnt hold the same amount of storytelling as in Hero. The movie had two superstar legends, it could have been done waayyy better..
